Lavender Cookies
By: Little Sky Lave...
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 5:01pm

Ingredients




3/4 cup Little Sky lavender sugar
1 stick unsalted butter, softened at room temperature
1 egg, slightly beaten
1 teaspoon lemon zest (optional)
1 cup all purpose flour (or rice flour can be substituted for a gl
1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder
1/4 teaspoon salt

Preparation

1 Combine the lavender sugar, butter, egg, and lemon zest (if using). 2 Beat until smooth. 3 Mix the other dry ingredients together with a fork. 4 Add to butter mixture and mix well. 5 Drop by scant teaspoons placing at least 2-3 inches apart as cookies will spread while baking, on cookie sheet lined with parchment paper. 6 Bake at 350° F, until edges turn brown (7 to 10 minutes).
